description: A rear single-storey extension at a home in Chantry, Ipswich, confirmed as lawful development ahead of construction.

caseStudy.heading: The Brief
caseStudy.text: Mr Deasy asked Architecture ONE to add a rear single-storey extension to his home at 75 Robin Drive, Chantry, Ipswich.

caseStudy.heading: The Approach
caseStudy.text: Architecture ONE prepared the proposed plans and secured a Certificate of Lawful Development confirming the rear extension could proceed as permitted development, before taking the scheme through building control.

caseStudy.heading: The Outcome
caseStudy.text: Ipswich Borough Council issued a Certificate of Lawful Development in February 2019 (ref. IP/18/01077/CLD), and a full plans building regulation application followed in March 2019.

note: Corrected from an earlier pass that classified this as a garage conversion. The Certificate of Lawful Development (IP/18/01077/CLD) and Building Notice both describe the works as a rear single-storey extension; projectType and description updated accordingly, and postcode (IP2 0TE) confirmed from those documents.
